recipe.visualDefinition: A four-panel grid composition featuring a single subject in various poses and scales, framed by a thick black outer border and thin inner colored rules, utilizing a warm, desaturated 1970s film aesthetic.
coreVisualRelationships: Four distinct photographic quadrants separated by thin vertical and horizontal dividers.
Subject consistency across all panels through wardrobe (brown henley) and environment.
Contrast between a heavy black outer frame and the vibrant, naturalistic photography within.
Typographic placement in the upper corners, balanced against the visual weight of the portraits.
coreInvariants: Desaturated earth-tone color palette (browns, greens, ochres).
Visible film grain and soft analog focus.
Consistent double-line inner border in light blue and tan.
High-contrast black background for the outer margins.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Top-left: extreme close-up; Top-right: medium shot seated; Bottom-left: full-body long shot; Bottom-right: low-angle medium shot.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The top-left quadrant's large-scale face acts as the primary entry point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Z-pattern movement from top-left close-up to top-right seated pose, down to bottom-left landscape, ending at bottom-right low-angle perspective.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black margins provide significant breathing room and focus the viewer's attention on the central grid.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep brown and olive green within the photos define the earthy mood.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Solid black outer frame creates a sharp boundary for the imagery.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Light sky blue and tan are used for the thin decorative inner borders.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high mid-tone density, typical of 1970s Ektachrome film processing.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or high-chroma synthetic colors.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: High-contrast, decorative serif with ball terminals and swashes.
letterConstructionRules: Extreme stroke contrast between thick and thin lines.
Tight letter spacing (kerning) typical of phototypesetting.
Pronounced teardrop terminals on lowercase letters.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Swash extensions on capital letters to cradle the following lowercase glyphs.

typesetting.alignment: Left and Right justified to corners

composition.position: Top corners of the black margin

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single decorative typeface used for all primary text to maintain 70s branding consistency.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the iconic 70s decorative serif look with teardrop terminals.
Provides the necessary high contrast and classic structure.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a 2x2 grid of four distinct photos of a man in a brown henley shirt. Top-left: headshot. Top-right: seated arms crossed. Bottom-left: standing in a field with trees. Bottom-right: low angle looking up. Apply a 1970s film grain and warm color grade. Surround the grid with a thick black border and a thin light-blue/tan double-line inner frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add white high-contrast decorative serif text in the top-left and top-right corners of the black border. Ensure tight kerning and swash-like terminals.

verificationChecks: Does the film grain look authentic to the 1970s?
Are the inner borders thin and precise?
Is the typography white and high-contrast against the black?

mustRedesign: Catalog numbers in the top left
postGenerationChecks: Check for four distinct camera angles.
Verify the presence of the double-line inner border.
Ensure the black margin is uniform on all sides.
Confirm the text is placed in the outer black area, not over the photos.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a single subject, photograph in four distinct scales/angles within one environment, place in a 2x2 grid, frame with a heavy black border and thin colored rules, and top with high-contrast 70s swash serifs.
